page.overview:
Who is Broque Madame?

Broque Madame returns in Mario & Luigi: Dream Team where she owns a new, fancy shop. She then reveals to Mario and Luigi that Peach and Toadsworth were disguised as Brocks. Broque Madame then suggests hiding Peach in the dream world to which everyone agrees to. Her Silver shop is open to everyone, while the fancier and expensive Gold shop is open only for the ones that reached the Rainbow Rank. The Gold shop is Blocked by a Brock named Britchard, but lets Mario and Luigi come to shop if they have the needed rank, and they also have healing service.
